regime_context: Chinese A-shares show an extreme one-narrative concentration: Banks dominate with the only eligible trend, near-record crowding (z=1.98) and intra-theme breadth of 0.944, while 20 of 22 themes are ineligible (below the absolute-trend gate). The backtest verdict is humbling on THIS market — the trend gate did NOT hold here historically (gate_helps=false, mean-reverting tape), and the desk's own track record shows directional accuracy of only 0.337 across 98 calls — so any directional lean here must be low-conviction and heavily conditional.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Coal's mean-revert hurst_tag flips to 'trend' and its durability_bar climbs above 0.8 while remaining eligible — that would signal a genuine, confirmed rotation away from the one-narrative Banks concentration. I am NOT predicting this; only waiting for the detector to confirm it.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Evidence of a ROTATION CONFIRMATION toward Banks: this is the only theme that clears the absolute-trend gate (eligible=true) with a durability_bar of 0.87 and hurst_tag 'trend' — consistent with a trend regime, not a mean-reverting one. Breadth of 0.944 shows the move is broad-based across constituents, and the rotation leader with a 0.87 durability bar suggests persistence of the leadership itself. This is a weak directional lean conditioned on the trend persisting, NOT a momentum return forecast.
evidence: Only theme with eligible=true under the absolute-trend gate
durability_bar 0.87 (strongest in the ranks) and hurst_tag 'trend'
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded (z=1.98, crowd_text=true) and carry the one_narrative dominant flag — historically such extreme concentration marks late-stage trend rather than fresh leadership. The backtest also says the trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on Chinese A-shares (gate_helps=false), and the desk's own 0.337 directional accuracy gives no confidence edge to lean on.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS (Banks ETF) closes below its own 20-day simple moving average while CSI 300 is flat or up — signalling the absolute-trend gate has flipped Banks ineligible during the horizon

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Evidence of a the rotation CHALLENGER structure: Coal is the only eligible theme apart from Banks (eligible=true, rank 2) but its durability_bar is much lower at 0.47 and hurst_tag is 'mean-revert' rather than 'trend'. This combination is internally inconsistent with continuing trend leadership and suggests the recent momentum is statistically mean-reverting rather than persistent. The narrow rotation (only 2 of 22 eligible) means capacity for leadership rotation is thin, and Coal's mean-revert profile argues against direction continuation.
theses.dissent: Coal is uncrowded (crowding_z 0.5, crowded=false), so there is no reflexivity/valuation cap against it continuing higher. It is the only eligible challenger to Banks and has the second-highest score — in a two-theme rotation the runner-up can catch up, especially with a mean-revert hurst tag that may simply reflect a short-term pullback before trend continuation.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS (Coal ETF) prints a new 20-day high with durability_bar rising above 0.8 — confirming trend conversion from mean-revert and retiring the 'mean-revert' tag as a headwind
